label: early-episode D2 arrival at S2 while the policy favours a2
explanation: Reset-gate unit 27 is active on about 1% of steps and never at GO. It is restricted to the early episode: almost all activity falls in ep_trial 3-29 and none after about trial 50. 55% of the mass is at D2, where it fires almost only when the state input is S2 (in_state==2, 4.4x lift), mostly after an a2 choice with a common transition, while the policy logit strongly favours a2 (choice < -4.44). The episodes are mostly ones that started with S2 good (start_high==0, 90% of mass). The largest activations are D2 arrivals at S2 via a rare transition after an a1 choice. It does not fire on D2 at S1. The other 45% of the mass is sparse but large D1 activations, usually after a rewarded trial (prev_reward==1), mostly following a rare transition (prev_common==0, 2x lift). I could not capture these: D1 predicates reached at most F1 0.11. The predicate uses only observed inputs, the model policy and episode time; no future variables. Magnitude is small overall (max 0.011) and the strongest activations are the rare a1->S2 D2 steps and the rewarded D1 steps, so the predicate covers only ~54% of the mass.
